---
name: Bug Report 错误报告
about: Create a bug report 创建一个错误报告
title: "[BUG] Some problem..."
labels: bug

---

### Describe the bug 描述你遇到的错误

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
一段简短的对于你遇到的错误的描述.

### Expected behavior 期待的行为

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
一段简短的对于你期待的行为的描述.

### Screenshots 屏幕截图

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.
如果可以的话, 提供屏幕截图对解决问题很有帮助.

### Build Environment 构建环境

- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS, Ubuntu]
- Theme version/commit [e.g. 0.4.0, 2ccba79]
- Hugo version and edition, the output of `hugo version` [e.g. hugo v0.170.1 ... linux/amd64]
- Dart Sass version, the output of `sass --version` [e.g. 1.108.2]

LoveIt requires Hugo 0.146.0 or later and Dart Sass. Please check both before opening the issue.
LoveIt 需要 Hugo 0.146.0 及以上版本和 Dart Sass, 请在创建 issue 之前先确认.

### Preview Environment 预览环境

- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS, Ubuntu, iOS, Android]
- Browser type/version [e.g. Chrome 103.0.5060.53, Safari 15.5, Edge 103.0.1264.37, Firefox 102.0]

### Additional Information 补充信息

Configuration files or front matter code...
配置文件或者前置参数的代码...
